title: Explanations for medical diagnosis predictions based on argumentation schemes
core_idea: Integrate argumentation schemes (a novel scheme based on Walton's abductive inference) with Bayesian networks by instantiating a structured explanation template using conditional probabilities from the network, converting them into statistical evidence that can support or challenge diagnostic conclusions to enhance transparency and interpretability of ML-based medical decision-making.
tldr: Combine an abductive argumentation scheme with Bayesian network probabilities to produce structured, statistical explanations for medical diagnosis predictions aimed at improving transparency and interpretability.
